description: Capability for the main window. Grants the core plugin permission set to the 'main' webview. Stage 3f-3a note: application-defined commands (main_window_hwnd, vst3_paths, append_error_log, open_devtools, get_engine_info) are NOT ACL-gated in Tauri v2 — they are registered via generate_handler and are invocable from every window listed here ('main'). There is no per-app-command permission identifier to 'allow'; inventing one fails the bundler's schema validation. The windows:['main'] scoping above IS the allow-list for the new main_window_hwnd command.
